scientific_integrity: Originality was evaluated against accessible full texts and bibliographic sources; complete Idso--Foster (1975) and Murphy (1962) text was unavailable, so priority risks remain. The attached verifier supplements, but does not prove, the global result.
scientific_limitations: An exact conditional theorem for instantaneous depth-mean gross rate with homogeneous fixed biomass, Steele response, Beer attenuation, fixed photophysiology, and adjustable optical depth; it does not model adaptive physiology, diurnal cycles, nutrients, sediment impacts, or field interventions. The integrated response formula predates this result; the claimed contribution is the sharp global optimizer classification and asymptotic law.
title: A sharp optical-depth optimum for a uniformly mixed photoinhibited water column
